title: Message Types
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
to the customer and explaining how items were cleared. Each Splitltem belongs to a SplitltemGroup. Open Splitltems of an Item

are grouped by due date and cash discount terms. So all the Splititems of a given Item that are due on the same date and have the
same cash discount percentage and cash discount dates belong to the same group.

Message Types

e ContractAccountERPSplitltemGroupByBusinessPartner|DQuery_sync

e ContractAccountERPSplitltemGroupByBusinessPartnerlDResponse_sync

Constraints

In case invoices have been partially cleared by payments in other currencies, errors may occur when you display the partial
amounts of the invoices.

Notes on SAP Implementation

Prerequisites

You are using software component FI-CA (as of version FI-CA 6.02).

You have maintained the backend configuration of SAP Biller Direct in FI-CA (see Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable
and Payable under Integration -> Financial Supply Chain Management -> Biller Direct -> Basic Setting for Customer Portal in
Internet ).

The user has sufficient authorizations, in particular with regard to the authorization object F_KK_EBPP.

Processing

FI-CA event 660lis called directly after inbound mapping of the service is done; it can be used to modify the query fields before the
business logic is performed.

FI-CA event 6602 is called before the response message is returned to the service consumer; it can be used to modify the
response fields and to handle customer extensions carried out in the service interface.

More Information

For information on corrections and frequently asked questions relating to this operation, refer to SAP Note 1063500 (collective
note).
